{{Top|leg}}
'''Master Trader''' was a title used by [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]]. High-ranking trade delegates in the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] [[Van Kellen]] held that title.<ref name="SN">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref> During the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] held the title of Master Trader.<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>
